messages.ko: 내생일 축하해준 모든웨이브들 너무너무 고맙고 감동이였어 생일 하루를 완벽하게 행복하개 만들어줘서 너무너무 기뻤어 진짜로 내 첫 생카도 만들어주고 많이 와줘서 고맙고 나축하해주는 해시태그도 다 봤어!! 편지도 다읽었어 너무 감사해 이렇게 과분한사랑 많이 줘서 진짜 고맙고 하루종일 고맙다고만 하는것같지만 너무 고마운데 고맙다라는 표현보다 더한걸 못찾겠어서 계속 말하고있어..ㅎㅎ 내가 이렇게 사랑받고있구나 다시한번 느끼는 하루였어 비록 지금 생일이 지나갔지만 잊을수없는 경험시켜줘서 고마워!!!
messages.en: Thank you so much to all the WAVs who wished me a happy birthday. I was truly touched. You made my birthday a perfectly happy day, and it made me so, so happy. Thank you for making my very first birthday café event and for coming to visit it. I saw all the hashtags celebrating my birthday too!! I read every single letter as well. Thank you so much for giving me so much love—more than I feel I deserve. I feel like I've been saying 'thank you' all day, but I'm just so thankful, and I can't find any words stronger than 'thank you,' so I keep saying it...ㅎㅎ It was a day that reminded me once again just how loved I am. Even though my birthday has already passed, thank you for giving me such an unforgettable experience!!!
